summary: One collapsible section: an always-visible title that toggles a region beneath it.
useWhen: inside an Accordion, once per section

title.note: always visible, so it must say what is inside — "Advanced" tells the user nothing about whether to open it

requires: a stable `id`, which is the section's identity in the open set — an index breaks the moment the list reorders
notes: the trigger carries aria-expanded and aria-controls; the panel is a region labelled by the trigger
the panel keeps its DOM when collapsed, so a half-filled form inside one does not lose its answers

antiPatterns.dont: a required form field inside a collapsed section
antiPatterns.do: keep required fields outside, or expand the section when validation fails
antiPatterns.why: a user cannot fix an error they cannot see, and the browser cannot focus a hidden invalid field
